History
This is the gallery subpage for the Scout. It contains images of every skin, descriptions, skin information and more.

Skin Upgrades

The Scout has thirty-one skins in total. This includes:

  1. The Default skin.
  2. Thirteen skins that can be obtained from Crates.
  3. Seven skins that can be unlocked from Passes.
  4. Three skins that can be obtained from both Crates and Passes.
  5. One skin that can be unlocked from Amazon Prime Gaming.
  6. One skin that can be unlocked from Codes.
  7. One skin that can be unlocked from the Merch Shop.
  8. Two skins that can be unlocked from triumphing a limited-time map.

Skin Trivia

  • The Scout is one of the most commonly used towers in various official game images and videos, such as Thumbnails or Trailers.
  • The Level 3+ armor that the Default and Bunny uses is the Scout armor from R2DA.
  • The Level 0-2 Intern shirt has a line of code that says "print("Hello world!")", which is a reference to Roblox's coding language Lua.
  • The Guest skin is based on Guests.
    • When upgraded to Level 4, the Guest skin will have a speech bubble appear above it, which is a reference to the Super Safe Chat feature that was once usable by Guests. It can say one of the following messages:
      • "I like your style"
      • "I can only use quick chat!"
      • "Hello"
      • "Hi"
      • "Go to sleep"
      • "Happy trails"
      • "Happy Easter"
      • "What's new?"
      • "Thanks for playing"
      • "Wanna be friends?"
    • The weapon it wields are the same weapons used by the Default Scout between the 13th of October 2019 and the 6th of April 2020.
  • The Guest skin is the first skin in the game to have a placement animation.
    • This animation, similarly to the rest of the skin, is a reference to old Roblox.
  • Interestingly, when the Guest Scout is selected to be placed, the text at the top of the green bar says "Guest 1457". However, when placed down, the number switches to 10.
  • The Guest skin's shooting sound is a distorted version of the default Commander's Level 0-3 shooting sound.
  • Multiple old versions of Scout's skins and the current Guest skin use this mesh for their HK P2000 pistol.
  • The King of Rock skin is based on the singer and actor Elvis Presley, who was called the "King of Rock and Roll".
  • During The Classic Event, the equipped Scout in the pre-loaded loadout in Classic Castle had the Guest skin equipped by default.
    • This no longer occurs if you activate Classic Castle through Sandbox Mode.

Roblox Catalog

  • The Default, Red, Green, Blue and Bunny skins' cap is a re-textured version of the French Brimmed Cap accessory from the Roblox catalog.
  • The Default, Red, Green, Blue, Black Ops, Bunny, Party and Golden skins' shades are the Sleek Tactical Shades accessory from the Roblox catalog.
  • The Level 2-3 version 2 and 3 Golden fedora is the Sparkle Time Fedora accessory from the Roblox catalog.
  • The Level 2-3 version 3 Survivor hat is the Errday Hat accessory from the Roblox catalog.
    • This accessory was also used by the Level 2-4 version 2 Survivor skin and the Level 5 version 1 Survivor skin.
  • The Level 2-5 version 1 and 2, and Level 2-4 version 3 of the Survivor scout skin use the Ninjafaic accessory from the Roblox catalog.
  • The Level 5 version 2 and Level 4 version 3 Golden guns are a re-textured version of the Hyperlaser-Gun gear from the Roblox catalog.
  • The original Level 5 Default helmet is the Operation Jungle Anticyclone accessory from the Roblox catalog.
    • The original Level 5 Red, Green and Blue skins used a re-textured version of this accessory.
  • The Level 2-3 version 3 Black Ops cap is a re-textured version of the Summertime 2009 R&R&R cap accessory from the Roblox catalog.
    • This accessory was also used by the Level 2-4 version 2 Black Ops skin and the Level 5 version 1 Black Ops skin.
  • The cap worn by the Guest skin is the Red Roblox Cap from the Roblox catalog.
  • The Banned skin, being a skin partially themed around older Roblox contains many accessories from it.
    • The destroyed crown worn it at Level 4 is a modified version of the The Void Star accessory.
    • The skull worn by it is the Skull accessory while its skeleton torso comes from the Skeleton bundle.

Update History

This only refers to cosmetic changes to the Scout. Check the main article for statistical changes.

  • 14 June 2019 - BETA v1.0.0
    • Scout added.
  • 13 October 2019 - Release v1.0.0
    • Default Level 0-5 appearance changed.
    • New skins: Red, Green, Blue, Survivor, Black Ops
  • 27 October 2019 - Release v1.1.1
    • New skin: Golden
    • Bug: Golden skin cosmetics are broken.
  • 28 October 2019 - Release v1.1.1b
    • Bugfix: Golden skin cosmetics are now fixed.
  • 9 November 2019 - Release v1.2.0
    • Black Ops and Survivor skins moved to Basic Crate.

    • New skin: Party
  • 1 April 2020 - Release v1.8.2
    • Funny Faces added.
  • 2 April 2020 - Release v1.8.2a
    • Funny Faces removed.
  • 6 April 2020 - Release v1.9.0
    • All skins Level 0-5 appearance changed.
    • New firing animations and SFX.
    • New skin: Bunny
  • 29 October 2020 - Overhaul v1.0
    • All skins Level 0-4 appearance changed (Level 5 removed).
    • Black Ops skin moved to Premium Crate.
    • Bug: The Green skin animations and cosmetics are broken.
  • 4 December 2021 - v1.0.0
    • All skins Level 0-4 appearance changed
    • Bugfix: The Green skin animations and cosmetics are fixed.
    • New Skin: Eclipse
  • 29 December 2021 - v1.0.0l

      • This was later fixed the same day.

    • New skins: Intern, Prime Raven

  • 22 March 2023 - v1.6.3f

    • Bug: Frost Hunter skin uses a wrong face in the lobby.

  • 5 May 2023 - v1.7.2

  • 28 October 2023 - v1.9.0
    • Default Level 0-4 appearance changed.

    • Intern skin added to the Premium Crate.
